title: FermiViewer project manifest (.fvp v2)
description: Schema for manifest.json inside a .fvp ZIP container. See docs/adr/0002-project-file-format.md. Unknown properties are permitted throughout and MUST be preserved verbatim on save, so a project written by a newer build is not degraded by an older one.

format.description: Magic string; lets a reader reject an unrelated JSON file before anything else.

version.description: Manifest version. v1 was the legacy two-file workspace (.json + .npz) and is read-only legacy.

generation.description: Random hex id for this save. Provenance and torn-write diagnosis; the single-file container makes it non-load-bearing.

saved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the save.

app_version.description: FermiViewer version that wrote the file.

name.description: Human-readable project name; independent of the filename.

payload_mode.description: light: source pixels referenced, derived images embedded. bundle: every image embedded and self-contained.

data_root_hint.description: Absolute path of the data root as seen on the writing machine, forward slashes. A HINT only — resolution falls back to the project file's own directory, then to a user re-point.

primary_param.description: Key into a sample's params naming the independent variable, so result-vs-parameter output and montage ordering need no prompt.

images.description: Every image in the project, in no particular order (ui_state.order governs display).

id.description: Stable id; also the pixels/<id>.npy and thumbs/<id>.png entry name.

kind.description: DataKind value; mirrors fermiviewer.datastruct.DataKind. rgb_image (ADR 0003) is an [H, W, 3] uint8 colour composite.

axes.description: One AxisCal per data dimension, except rgb_image which carries its two SPATIAL axes only (the channel dim has no calibration semantics — ADR 0003). An axis is calibrated iff scale is finite and non-zero AND units is non-empty.

metadata.description: JSON-safe parser metadata (vendor, beam_kv, content_rows, ...). Non-representable values were dropped at save time.

embedded.description: True iff pixels/<id>.npy exists in this container. Always true for derived images, in BOTH payload modes, because they have no source file.

rel.description: Source path relative to the data root, POSIX separators. Required when embedded is false. Must not be absolute and must not escape the root with '..'.

source.description: Original absolute path at import, kept as provenance only. Never used for resolution.

size_bytes.description: Source file size, for a cheap check that a re-pointed folder holds the expected data.

sha256.description: Optional content hash for strict verification after relocation. Omitted by default — hashing a whole study on every save is not worth the time.

derived_from.description: Parent image id when this image was produced by a filter/crop/analysis rather than read from disk.

unavailable.description: Written true when the previous load could not resolve this image. Advisory: it is re-derived on load, and its presence must never cause the entry to be dropped.

samples.description: Samples and projects. A sample IS an ImageGroup (frontend/src/lib/groups.ts) extended with params and parent; there is no separate grouping mechanism.

image_ids.description: Ordered member ids. MAY contain ids no longer present; readers prune for display and MUST keep them on save. An image id may appear in more than one sample.

parent.description: Parent sample id, giving project -> sample nesting. Null for a root. Cycles are invalid.

params.description: Named experimental parameters for this sample, keyed by parameter name.

value.description: Numeric for anything to be plotted against; string for categorical.

unit.description: Physical unit of value, e.g. degC, nm, sccm. Null for dimensionless or categorical.

color.description: Optional display colour for this sample in sections, panes and plots.

measures.description: Annotations and regions, keyed by image id. Region areas are derived from pts and the image's axis calibration — never stored, so they cannot go stale against a recalibration.

kind.description: polygon and lasso are the closed area kinds; both are measured by one shared area computation.

pts.description: Normalized 0-1 image coordinates, so a measure survives derived images of the same aspect ratio.

holes.description: Enclosed holes subtracted from this region's area (item 19). Each entry is one hole's ring, same normalized 0-1 point-list shape as pts. Absent/empty = no holes.

results.description: Persistent analysis results (ADR 0004). Each entry is a lightweight record of one analysis run; large output arrays live as results/<result-id>/ ZIP members referenced by outputs[].member, NEVER inline here. A record whose members are missing from the container still loads, degraded — its presence must never fail a project load.

id.description: Stable result id; also names the results/<id>/ member directory, so it must be a single safe path component.

schema.description: Revision of this record's shape, so a future build can migrate records individually without re-versioning the container.

analysis.description: Analysis type identifier, e.g. eds.quantify, measure.profile, structure.particles, diffraction.index.

label.description: Short human description of this run.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the computation (not of the save).

app_version.description: FermiViewer version that computed the result.

status.description: Record vocabulary, deliberately distinct from the job poller's queued/running/done/error: a failed or cancelled run is recorded separately from completed science, never as some of it.

source_ids.description: Input image ids. MAY name ids no longer present; readers prune for display and MUST keep them on save (same rule as samples.image_ids).

derived_ids.description: Ids of images this analysis produced (element maps, label maps, ...). Same keep-on-save rule as source_ids.

region_ids.description: Ids of the LIVE measures/ROIs the analysis was restricted to, for linking while they still exist. Same keep-on-save rule as source_ids. The geometry itself is in regions[] — a region edited or deleted later must not change what this record meant.

regions.description: SNAPSHOTS of the region definitions used, copied at compute time (conventionally the measures[] entry shape: id, kind, pts, holes, ...). Same copy-not-reference rule as calibration: region_ids link, regions reproduce. Kept schematically permissive until the roadmap item-4 canonical geometry contract; preserved verbatim on save.

params.description: RESOLVED parameters (defaults filled in) — the reproduction key for a rerun. Non-finite floats were scrubbed at save time.

calibration.description: Per-source calibration SNAPSHOTS, copied at compute time: recalibrating an image later must not silently rewrite what a stored result meant. The deliberate inverse of the measures rule (areas derived, never stored). Axes are the first supported snapshot content: roadmap item 5 extends entries with quantitative keys (detector/profile/standard identity, efficiency, dose, factor sets, uncertainties); readers MUST preserve keys they do not model verbatim on save, like everywhere else in this schema.

axes.description: One AxisCal per data dimension of the source at compute time, same shape as images[].axes.

source.description: Where the calibration came from — the image's metadata.calibration_source convention (fei, gatan, db:<key>, ...).

warnings.description: Scientific caveats attached to the result (poor counts, peak interference, extrapolation, ...), kept beside the numbers they qualify.

error.description: What went wrong, for status failed/cancelled. Null when completed.

outputs.description: Named outputs. One shared envelope for every workshop; per-kind data conventions are ADR 0004 §3.

kind.description: The closed set of output shapes (roadmap item 1).

name.description: Name unique within this record, e.g. composition, profile, particles.

data.description: Small inline JSON payload (a scalar's value/unit/sigma, a table's columns/units, a curve's axis names). Large numeric payloads belong in member.

member.description: results/<result-id>/<n>.npy ZIP entry holding this output's array. Null for a fully-inline output. Must live under the OWNING record's results/<id>/ directory (a reference into another record's directory is aliasing, not sharing) and must be unique across the whole section. A member the container does not hold — or holds corrupted — degrades the record on load; a re-save keeps the dangling reference rather than destroying the evidence.

regions.description: Named region sets and the class vocabulary they use (ADR 0006, roadmap item 4). Geometry is 0-based (row, col) float with INCLUSIVE bounds and implicitly-closed rings — the calc.regions convention, stated by the schema number alone and deliberately NOT repeated as a prose 'convention' field, which is how results[].regions ended up carrying three mutually inconsistent spellings. Distinct from measures (normalized 0-1 (x, y) annotations, drawn to read a number off) and from results[].regions (a compute-time snapshot, frozen so editing a set cannot rewrite what a past result reports). Supersedes the unvalidated ui_state.savedRois.

schema.description: Revision of this section's shape AND the sole statement of its coordinate convention, so a future build can migrate region sets without re-versioning the container.

classes.description: The project's class vocabulary. DESCRIPTIVE, not a foreign key: Region.region_class is free text by contract, so a region may carry a class never declared here and it round-trips intact.

label.description: Display name; the id is used when absent.

color.description: Presentational only; no format is imposed.

sets.description: Each set is a named group of regions drawn on one image.

id.description: Stable set id, unique within the project.

image_id.description: The images[].id this set was drawn on. NOT validated against images: a set whose image is temporarily unresolvable is data to preserve, exactly as an unavailable image keeps its reference (ADR 0002 §4).

id.description: Stable region id, unique within its set.

region_class.description: Free text; the vocabulary is the user's. See classes[].

parts.description: Applied left to right, so an include after an exclude puts pixels back. ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT, and the first part must include, since an exclusion subtracts from nothing.

shape.description: One primitive outline. Exactly one of bounds and outline is present, decided by kind: a polygon carries an outline, every other kind carries bounds. Carrying both would serialize two contradictory geometries with one silently ignored at rasterization.

kind.description: rect and ellipse read bounds as the PIXEL FOOTPRINT they name, so an ellipse over n pixels has semi-axis n/2 and matches the inscribed-ellipse ROI of calc.profile_stats.roi_stats. circle reads bounds as the disc's true bounding box, so its centre is the midpoint and its radius half the extent, giving dist <= r. Those are not the same set of pixels, and the kind is what tells them apart.

bounds.description: [r0, c0, r1, c1], 0-based and INCLUSIVE on all four sides, normalized so r0 <= r1 and c0 <= c1. A circle's row and column extents must be equal.

holes.description: Inner rings subtracted from THIS shape. Distinct from an exclude part, which subtracts from the whole region.

ui_state.description: Presentational state, deliberately UNVALIDATED beyond being an object: views, display windows, overlay style, savedRois, sbsPanes/sbsRows/sbsCols, browseScale. Passed through verbatim so its shape stays free to change without a format revision.

regionRing.description: A closed ring of at least 3 vertices, as [row, col] pairs. The closing edge is implicit: do NOT repeat the first vertex.
